The Wither was beaten, but the Wither Blight still spread through the overworld.
The Builders resolved to cleanse it wholly.
At the very center of the overworld they raised a great structure —
a pyramid, its summit a single platform.
They carried a nether star up from the Nether and shaped it into the beacon,
and set it on the pyramid's crown.
A column of light rose from the beacon into the sky —
golden, pure, flooding the whole overworld.
the blue haze dissolved, and green grass grew back across the land.
The Builders believed they had won.
